content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Outsourced HR, payroll and workers' compensation insurance for small businesses; no consumer debt purchasing or collection."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Managed care and claims cost containment for employers and insurers; does not buy or collect consumer debt."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Insurance claims adjusting for insurers and employers; does not purchase or collect consumer receivables."},{"label":"C4","good":true,"reason":"Buys charged-off consumer debt portfolios from banks and collects from consumers, matching the target's core model."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Pawn loans and used merchandise retail for individuals; no purchase or collection of charged-off consumer debt."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Franchised insurance brokerage earning commissions on policy placement; does not collect consumer debt."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Consumer remittance money transfers; shares a consumer customer base but no debt purchasing or collection."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"AI lending platform and loan funding network; originates and funds loans rather than buying and collecting charged-off debt."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Lease-to-own payment plans for merchandise purchases; does not buy charged-off debt or collect defaulted balances."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Commercial and personal insurance brokerage and program administration; no debt collection business."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Rent-to-own retail stores and lease-to-own financing for household goods; not charged-off debt collection."}]}
